title: The upgrade guidance for consumers exists only inside closed ledger records
foundBy: consumer report on three applications pinned to 0.2.1-dev, verified against 0c015ef
details:
There is no `CHANGELOG.md` and no migration document, and `package.json` still reads `0.2.0` while `Page.tsx`, `Tooltip.md`, `Tree.md`, `Panel.md` and `catalog.json` all document props as `since: 0.3.0`.

The range carries at least one changed signature, `MarkdownMinimap` moving from `contentRef` to `content: HTMLElement | null`; two deliberate default flips, `Tree.labelOverflow` to `"truncate"` and `Tree.scrollSelectedIntoView` to `true`; one prop whose meaning changed in place on `MarkdownViewer`; four parser changes that alter rendered markdown; a new stylesheet requirement; a new `Page` export; and `SectionedTree.expandAllControl` widening to a union where `false` now removes a control it used to leave standing.

The guidance for most of this is already written, in the `notes` of closed records including CUI-005, CUI-007 and CUI-008. A consumer cannot find it there. Collecting it is the difference between an upgrade that takes an hour and one that takes a day, and the prose mostly exists already.
